baseline.selection: Health-only full trajectory maxima with 10% margin; no fault or test outcomes.

parameters.training: Healthy-only maxima. No fault/test metrics. Sensor profiles calibrated separately.

seed_reuse: Seeds reused across scenarios and noise strata. Wake phases reuse the same trajectories; not independent experiments.
